create_projection_non_negative: create a projection that clips a JAX tree to the non-negative orthant using relu
create_projection_simplex: create a projection that maps a JAX tree onto the probability simplex with a given scale
create_projection_l1_ball: create a projection that maps a JAX tree onto the l1 ball with a given radius
create_projection_l2_ball: create a projection that maps a JAX tree onto the l2 ball with a given radius
create_projection_halfspace: create a projection that maps a JAX tree onto a halfspace defined by a normal vector and scalar
